dict.string: Only if you add a plug-in folder that lives on the Desktop. MK Studio Upkeep reads plug-in bundle metadata there and changes nothing.
Only if you add a plug-in folder that lives in Documents. MK Studio Upkeep reads plug-in bundle metadata there and changes nothing.
Only if you add a plug-in folder that lives in Downloads. MK Studio Upkeep reads plug-in bundle metadata there and changes nothing.
Only if you add a plug-in folder on an external drive. MK Studio Upkeep reads plug-in bundle metadata there and changes nothing.
Only if you add a plug-in folder on a network volume. MK Studio Upkeep reads plug-in bundle metadata there and changes nothing.

When you confirm removal of eligible software from a protected application or plugin folder, MK Studio Upkeep asks Finder to move the selected bundle to Trash. macOS may request administrator permission. Nothing else is sent to Finder.
